hint_ladder: Say what you believe is true while marking that your information may be out of date.
Use the phrase at the front of the sentence, before the comma.
Start with the words: ___, the shop is still open.
teaching_content.reveal_form: As far as I know, the shop is still open.
canonical_forms: As far as I know, the shop is still open.
alternative_realizations: As far as I know, the meeting is still on for Friday.
